Attached is our marked MSA with comments and proposed alternative language (see inline). High level:
- Section 5.2 (Data use): we need stronger limitations on analytics and an explicit permitted purpose clause.
- Section 7.1 (Indemnity): we asked for mutual indemnity for third-party claims related to integration failures.
- Section 10.5 (Termination for convenience): we asked for 60 days’ notice vs. 30.

I flagged a few non-blocking items with suggested wording to expedite. I’ve attached the document as "Nimbus-MSA_Redlines_v3-reviewed.docx" (we uploaded to our SharePoint).

Given these requests, our estimated internal legal cycle is 5–7 business days. If Redwood can accept alternative wording on 5.2 and 10.5 (we provided samples), we may be able to shorten that.

Thanks —
Tom Hsu

Elena / Tom —

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Tom. Redwood legal reviewed your suggested language and we can accept the proposed compromise for Section 10.5 (terminate for convenience -> 60 days) and the alternative analytics permitted-purpose clause for 5.2 with a minor edit. On indemnity (7.1), legal is proposing a limited mutual indemnity tied to third-party IP claims only — I’ve pasted the exact proposed sentence below.

Proposed indemnity language (single line, accepted by Redwood counsel):
"Each party shall indemnify the other for third-party claims alleging infringement of intellectual property arising solely from the indemnifying party's deliverables or modifications."

Next steps to keep us on target for a Feb 24 procurement milestone:
- Tom: if Nimbus legal approves the revised indemnity sentence, please confirm by EOD 02/18 so we can circulate a clean MSA.
- Elena: please send completed vendor intake + W-9 to vendor-ops@nimbuspay.com by 02/19 to hit PO timeline.
- Vivek: please upload finalized BOM numbers to the shared drive and I will update the order form (due 02/18).

If we can close these items this week we should be able to execute the order before 02/24. If not, call out the blockers and we’ll plan an expedited exec approval.

Thanks —
